question.worked_solution:
If $X$ follows a discrete uniform distribution over a set $S,$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{|S|}, & x\in S \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, we have $X∼U\{11,13,14,16,20\},$ and the set $S=\{11,13,14,16,20\}$ has $|S|=5$ items. So, we have

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{5}, & x=11,13,14,16,20 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

In $S,$ there are $2$ items $(13,14)$ that satisfies $13\le X<16.$ Therefore,

$$
P(13\le X<16)=2\cdot \frac{1}{5}=\frac{2}{5}.
$$
